desc:
Chewits XTREME Sour Apple Chews Multipack packs an explosively tangy punch that’ll wake up your tastebuds from the very first chew. Bursting with intensely sour apple flavour and loaded with that signature chewy bite, these sweets are not for the faint-hearted.

Chewits · Multipack
ingredients:
Sour Apple Flavoured Chewy Sweets

Ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, acids (citric acid, lactic acid), vegetable fats (palm, coconut), apple juice from concentrate (3%), natural flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein, colours (copper complexes of chlorophyllins, curcumin).
